passed: An open print preview removes stale pixels and disables printing after redaction or deletion.
Two documents cannot export the same capture concurrently; the rejected attempt leaves the active export intact.
Editing and case deletion reject a pending folder export without losing the image; editing works once export finishes.
Deleting a case during its pending folder export is rejected atomically.
A stale editor cannot replace a newer redaction with pixels from its older image.
An interrupted old export cannot overwrite the status of its successful retry.
Restoring a binary backup made during folder export keeps its image and permits an immediate retry.
Clipboard conversion rejects bytes when the selected image changes during PNG preparation.
A durable screenshot releases its capture lock even when preview loading fails; focus restores the preview.
A delayed clipboard failure after deletion keeps completion actions disabled and reports that the capture was deleted.
